capabilities: send the open note or the current selection to Publora as a post
publish now, schedule for a chosen time, or save as a draft in Publora
attach images and videos embedded in the note to the post
add an optional first comment on supported networks
count characters per network and warn when a post is too long
extras: The free Publora plan allows 15 posts a month and three connected accounts. Pinterest accounts can be connected but not posted to yet. Files are uploaded from the vault straight to Publora's storage; the sign-in token or API key is stored in vault plugin data and sent only to Publora.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a note into a post on social networks; you have to copy text and media out by hand to publish or schedule it.

relations.evidence: creates a post in Publora: published right away, scheduled for a time you pick, or saved as a draft

requires.name: Publora API key (alternative to signing in)

summary: Social media publisher that sends the current note or selection to Publora for posting, scheduling or saving as a draft on ten networks.
